messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":5,"verses":[{"chapter":5,"verse":11,"text":"11 And he left the city, and as he searched he saw the landmarks of the city, and he said: “Indeed, this is the city. I lost my way.”"},{"chapter":5,"verse":12,"text":"12 And again he returned to the city and searched, and found no one of his own people, and he said: “Blessed be the Lord, for a great trance has come over me!”"},{"chapter":5,"verse":13,"text":"13 And again he left the city, and he stayed there grieving, not knowing where he should go."},{"chapter":5,"verse":14,"text":"14 And he put down the basket, saying: “I will sit here until the Lord takes this trance from me.”"},{"chapter":5,"verse":15,"text":"15 And as he sat, he saw an old man coming from the field, and Abimelech said to him: “I say to you, old man, what city is this?”"}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 11,12,13,14,15 in this chapter.
